added.name: rekursiv.ai
added.long_description:
We're scaling self-improving AI scientist teams to ideate/experiment/discover, generating new knowledge autonomously. Their discoveries reduced ARC-1/2 costs by 10,000× while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy and yielded material advances on combinatorial ML problems.

We believe that AI is bounded not by compute, but ideas. Scaling to millions of sessions of discovery enables leveraging its own discoveries and presents a novel training source capable of ushering a new era of self-reliant foundational models.
added.one_liner: Scale AI scientists whose own breakthroughs accelerate the next.

added.name: Vendo
added.long_description:
Vendo is the customization layer that lets your users build their own features and micro-apps directly on top of your product. Rather than waiting on an ever-growing feature backlog, your users can personalize the product to exactly how they work, create their own automations, and integrate hundreds of external tools, all without your team writing a line of code.

Everything runs on your existing API, renders natively in your own theme and components, and executes inside secure sandboxes within your existing security guardrails, so your source code is never touched. Companies can plug Vendo into an agent they already have, or deploy a production-ready agent complete with the ability to take actions in the product, generate UI, and draw on a built-in knowledge base. Vendo is open source and installs with a single command, and we work closely with teams to get it running for their product.
added.one_liner: Let your users build their own features on top of your product

long_description.before:
Endstack is a desktop OS optimized for humans and agents running in the cloud.

Your desktop is powered by endOS, giving you a real desktop workspace in the browser backed by Linux in the cloud. Files, notes, browser tabs, native apps, terminals, and all your agents in one beautiful, familiar, interface.

You get a powerful agent running 24/7, integrated at the system level into endOS that you can also reach via Slack, email, or SMS. 

Endstack desktops are also natively multiplayer, allowing for realtime collaboration with teammates.
long_description.after:
Endstack is a full desktop, collaborative workspace built for humans and agents running in the cloud available on web, desktop, and mobile.

Each workspace powered by endOS, giving you a familiar channel-based experience augmented by a real desktop environment. The desktop is backed by Linux and ships with a built-in Chrome browser. Files, notes, browser tabs, native apps, terminal, and all your agents in a single beautiful, unified interface. 

At the center of it all you get a powerful agent running 24/7 that you can also reach via Slack, email, or SMS.

one_liner.before: Cloud desktop OS for humans and agents
one_liner.after: The complete, collaborative workspace for humans and agents

long_description.before: At Ember, we're tackling one of healthcare's most costly and overlooked challenges: the massive inefficiency in clinical documentation and revenue cycle management. Medical practices lose billions annually due to incomplete documentation, missed billing opportunities, and denied claims - issues that stem from antiquated systems that force clinicians to choose between patient care and paperwork. We combine ambient listening technology with deep understanding of medical billing requirements to eliminate the administrative burden that plagues healthcare providers.
long_description.after:
Ember is rebuilding the back office of healthcare finance.

Behind every provider sits a mountain of administrative complexity, and that drag lands where it matters most: cost, capacity, and care. Ember clears it with intelligent automation, so provider groups can spend their time on patients, not paperwork.

We're reimagining how revenue moves through healthcare, and how lean teams scale without trading away quality. Our platform drops into existing provider workflows, takes the manual work off their plate, and gives leaders real-time visibility into financial and operational performance.

We're growing fast, and we're hiring sharp, resourceful people who want to build. Right now, that starts with you.
